About Zorawar

A name that
means strength.

Zorawar — a name rooted in strength and light. Our little Zora came into this world on a January morning, bringing with him a calm so profound it changed everything in the room.

Every small yawn, every tiny curl of his fingers, every sleepy sound — these are the moments we are collecting, one precious day at a time. He fills our home with a warmth we never knew we were missing.

A note for Zora
"You are the reason our hearts learned to hold more than we ever thought possible."

Dear Zorawar — you came into this world with the quietest entrance and made the loudest noise in our hearts. We watch you sleep and wonder how we ever lived without the sound of your breathing. We feed you every few hours through the night and not one moment feels like anything but pure love. You are our greatest adventure, our most important work, and our deepest joy — all in one tiny, perfect person.

We are cheering for every single gram, every smile, every stretch. You've got this, our little warrior.

— Mama & Papa, always & forever ♡
